# B"H
<!-- Boruch Hashem -->
<!-- Blessed is He -->

# Deployment Policy Evidence

> The Awtsmoos guards the secret while every public garment receives its measured name;
> Awtsmoos.com accepts only hash-proven streams through an owner-authorized flame.

## Proven Historical Contract

- Commit `676ee3033` moved all nineteen Mitzvah World GLBs from Git into authenticated Awtsmoos Drive.
- Runtime root: `https://awtsmoos.com/sites/firebase_drive_migration/assets/mitzvah-world/models/`.
- Logical path: `assets/mitzvah-world/models/<family>/<sha256>/<filename>.glb`.
- Public visibility and immutable caching are required.
- The original upload credential existed only in process memory and was revoked after migration.
- Local source keeps semantic identities, exact byte counts, and SHA-256 values.

## Live Drift Evidence

- The Drive alias remains healthy: known terrain textures return HTTP 200 through `/sites` and `/api/social/drive/public`.
- Chossid and a second recorded model return HTTP 404 through logical, public, and immutable model routes.
- Therefore model entries and objects are absent; this is not a general Drive outage.
- The public compact bundle is stale relative to the locally generated artifact.

## Authorized Publication Vessel

1. Verify every local content-addressed GLB against `RemoteModelRecords.js`.
2. Require a fresh ephemeral `AWTSMOOS_DRIVE_API_KEY` with `drive.write` for alias `firebase_drive_migration`.
3. Upload each file with:
   - deterministic SHA-derived idempotency key;
   - `x-drive-visibility: public`;
   - `x-drive-cache-policy: immutable`;
   - exact content length and GLB content type.
4. Verify response metadata without logging the credential.
5. Re-download every public object and verify bytes plus SHA-256.
6. Preserve a non-secret JSON receipt containing paths, hashes, sizes, statuses, and timestamps.
7. Remove the credential from process memory when the command exits; never write it to disk.

## Completion Boundary

The model deployment closes only when all nineteen logical public URLs return their recorded bytes and hashes. Source deployment closes separately when the live compact bundle matches the locally verified artifact and the browser reports playable readiness without fatal console or network errors.
